title: The Family Heirloom
description: An old woman in Elder Moor was run off the Crossroads road by bandits and dropped her mother's ring somewhere in the grass. It is not worth much as gold. It was her mother's, and her mother's before that, and her knees will not carry her back to look. She says she would not ask if she could still make the walk.

objectives.description: Search the Crossroads road where she was run off it

notes: Threat: an old woman ran off the Crossroads road by bandits, too frail to walk back for what she dropped. Giver motive: family memento, three generations, shame at asking a stranger for something so small. Consequence of refusal: unwired - she keeps the hole in her family's history.
